snippet.title: MINA - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
MINA, The cybercat and the mascot of our studio, is appearing for the first time in indle games! 

"MINA" is a fast-paced 2D arcade game where you take control of Mina, the Cybercat, as she dives deep into a collapsing cave filled with danger, treasure, and chaos!

The game will release on Itch.io and Gamejolt in 15 October, 2025!
(inclued a pack called "Cyberdiamond Pack" that will cost 1,50$)
